title: The synthesis and antitumor activity of novel 1,3,5,2‐trizaphosphorines linked with nitrogen mustards
abstract: AbstractA series of novel derivatives of 2,5‐dihydro‐1,3,5,2‐triazaphosphorine has been synthesized and the structures of the most stable tautomers have been confirmed by 1H NMR and IR spectroscopy, MS, elemental analyses, and quantum chemistry calculations. We suggest that the thioenol form is more stable than the thione form which has been thought to be more stable up to the present time. The bioassay tests indicated that most of the new products have good antitumor activity.
